message:
The other evening, we had a sudden power outage just as I was settling in with a good book. I had just finished my favorite chapter when the lights flickered and went out—talk about a plot twist! Luckily, I had charged up my little power bank earlier that day, so I was able to keep my phone lit and even made a quick call to check on my neighbor, who was also in the dark. 

I grabbed a lantern and found a cozy spot by the window, feeling surprisingly content as I listened to the gentle rustle of the trees outside. It reminded me that a little preparation can turn a minor inconvenience into a chance to slow down and enjoy the moment. 

What’s your go-to tip for making the best of a blackout?
